map.二次函数 y = ax² + bx + c 的顶点坐标。: The vertex coordinates of the quadratic y = ax2 + bx + c.
map.x_v = −b/(2a)，y_v = a·x_v²+b·x_v+c。 y=x²: x_v = -b/(2a), y_v = a·x_v2+b·x_v+c. For y=x2-4x+3 the vertex is (2, -1).
map.📚 深度解析：由二次函数求顶点与对称轴（x_v=−b/2a，y_v=f(x_v): 📚 Deep Dive: Vertex and axis of symmetry from a quadratic (x_v=-b/2a, y_v=f(x_v))
map.轨迹顶点：抛体运动最高/最低点对应抛物线顶点: Trajectory vertex: the highest / lowest point of projectile motion is the parabola vertex
map.最值问题：利润、面积等目标函数的极值位置（x_v）: Optimisation: the extremum position (x_v) of objective functions such as profit or area
map.函数作图：由顶点与对称轴快速勾勒抛物线形状: Graphing: sketch the parabola quickly from its vertex and axis of symmetry
map.算法：顶点横坐标 x_v=−b/(2a)，纵坐标 y_v=f(x_v)=a·x_: Algorithm: the abscissa is x_v=-b/(2a) and the ordinate y_v=f(x_v)=a·x_v2+b·x_v+c; the axis of symmetry is x=x_v. If a=0 it is not a quadratic and the tool outputs nothing. Requires a not equal to 0.
map.例：y=x²−4x+3（a=1,b=−4,c=3）→ x_v=−(−4)/(2×: Example: y=x2-4x+3 (a=1,b=-4,c=3) gives x_v=-(-4)/(2x1)=2.0000 and y_v=1x4-4x2+3=-1.0000, so the vertex is (2,-1) and the curve opens upward (a>0). For y=2x2+4x (a=2,b=4,c=0), x_v=-1.0000 and y_v=-2.0000, giving vertex (-1,-2).
map.怎么判断顶点是最值？: How do I tell whether the vertex is an extremum?
map.a>0 抛物线开口向上、顶点为最小值；a<0 开口向下、顶点为最大值；x_v 即: If a>0 the parabola opens upward and the vertex is a minimum; if a<0 it opens downward and the vertex is a maximum; x_v is where the extremum occurs and y_v is its value.
map.a=0 退化为一次函数 y=bx+c（直线），没有抛物顶点；本工具要求 a≠0，: With a=0 it degenerates to the linear function y=bx+c (a straight line) with no parabola vertex; this tool requires a not equal to 0, so check whether a coefficient was entered wrongly.
